content.short: Axelar is the full-stack Web3 interoperability layer enabling secure cross-chain messaging and smart contract communication across blockchains.
content.description: Axelar Network provides universal cross-chain communication infrastructure for Web3 applications, enabling general message passing so smart contracts on one chain can trigger actions on another  going beyond simple asset transfers. Its decentralized validator network and General Message Passing (GMP) SDK make it easy for developers to build cross-chain applications with strong security guarantees. Axelar is deployed on Mantle as a core communication infrastructure layer connecting Mantle dApps to dozens of other blockchains.
content.meta: Axelar is a full-stack Web3 interoperability layer enabling cross-chain communication on Mantle. Discover Axelar on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
